mentions.notes: More Fallow visited and gave enthusiastic personal opinions. Described as probably the best Indian food in London with Lucknow-based cuisine. Praised exceptional papadums, two-Michelin star soup, lamb brains, and overall fantastic food and restaurant concept.
mentions.verdict: Fantastic food, fantastic restaurant, fantastic concept.

mentions.notes: They visited this place and spoke with the founder who opened it in 1982. Jack described it as 'the best kebab of my life' - very delicious, clean, not greasy, with uniform minced meat. The founder recommended eating it simply with just onion, chili sauce, and lemon juice.
mentions.verdict: Best kebab of my life - clean, not greasy.
dishes: Doner kebab (100% lamb shoulder, kufta style)

mentions.notes: Their final kebab stop visited around 1 am where they tried chicken doner, veal doner, and lamb doner. The chicken doner was described as comforting and well-made with high-quality ingredients, though not as luxurious as the lamb and veal options. Will and Jack discussed the quality and textures of each.
mentions.verdict: High-quality ingredients; chicken good but lamb/veal more luxurious.

mentions.notes: More Fallow competed in Bentley's Oyster Festival as defending champions of 2026, creating multiple oyster dishes including one with ponzu sauce, truffle, nori and hazelnuts, and another with tuna, artichoke puree, and shiso.
mentions.verdict: Won the oyster competition with innovative tuna and truffle dish.
dishes: Oyster with ponzu sauce and truffle with mustard and nori
Oyster with tuna, artichoke puree, hazelnuts and shiso

mentions.videoTitle: Chefs Review One of London's Oldest Restaurants ft. Lagom Chef
mentions.notes: More Fallow visited for breakfast and praised it as serving London's best eggs Benedict, croissants, full English breakfast, and French toast. Called it 'flawless' with no complaints.
mentions.verdict: Flawless breakfast with the best eggs Benedict in London.

mentions.videoTitle: Chefs Review the Best Ever Seafood Meal
mentions.notes: Josh Niland's pop-up at Dorian. Will and Jack dined there and gave extensive, enthusiastic reviews of the entire meal, calling it one of the best seafood experiences they've had, with particular praise for the creativity, fish preparation, and dishes like the sea bass, blue mackerel, tuna Wellington, John Dory, and tuna cheeseburger.
mentions.verdict: One of the best seafood meals ever tasted.
dishes: Sea bass with egg and flour noodles
Cold Kiss sea bass with soba noodles
Blue mackerel with garam and oil
John Dory cooked on the bone
Sea bass rib with muscovado and soy glaze

mentions.notes: Mentioned as one of the five best restaurants in London alongside Legacy.
mentions.verdict: One of the five best restaurants in London.

mentions.videoTitle: What Chef Techniques Are Actually Worth It?
mentions.notes: More Fallow visited The Ritz for fine dining and personally experienced a pigeon dish cooked in a press with flambéed brandy/cognac and pan jus, which they described as incredibly romantic.
mentions.verdict: Flambéed pigeon dish was incredibly romantic.
dishes: Flambéed pigeon with cognac pan jus

mentions.videoTitle: Chefs Review the Best Steakhouse in the UK
mentions.notes: More Fallow visited and praised it as probably the best steakhouse in the UK. They appreciated the excellent quality beef, lamb, and pork cooked using traditional iron-pressing methods over coal. They commended the meat sourcing, simplicity of menu, generous portions, outstanding sides (bone marrow, béarnaise, chips, salads), and fair pricing for the quality.
mentions.verdict: Incredible steakhouse with exceptional meat quality and service.

mentions.videoTitle: Chefs Review the Best Pizza in the UK
mentions.notes: More Fallow visited this new pub in Mayfair and praised Crisp pizza as the best in the UK and possibly the world. They highlighted the exceptional crispiness of the base, perfectly balanced flavors, and incredible cooking technique by pizzamaker Pedro.
mentions.verdict: Best pizza in the UK, possibly the world.
